2609.08404.title: Environments as Scaffold: Enriching Feedback to Bootstrap Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Tasks
2609.08404.paper_summary: Large Language Models demonstrate remarkable proficiency in static reasoning, yet training them as autonomous agents through Reinforcement Learning (RL) for long-horizon tasks is often hindered by severe reward sparsity. While conventional \textit{agent-side warming} up via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can alleviate this, it is frequently limited by data scarcity and constrained exploration. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift to \textit{environment-side adaptation} by constructing \textbf{F}eedback-\textbf{E}nriched \textbf{E}nvironments (\textbf{FEEs}). Through a pilot study, we establish a feedback design strategy that reformulates environments by transitioning from action guidance to observation enrichment during the later stages of both intra-episode exploration and inter-episode evolution. Large-scale experiments on SciWorld and BFCL benchmarks using various Qwen3 model scales and RL algorithms such as GRPO, GSPO, and DAPO demonstrate that FEEs consistently yield performance improvements over standard settings. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that training with FEEs \textbf{(1)} stabilizes training dynamics by reducing entropy volatility, \textbf{(2)} facilitates proactive state-space exploration in difficult tasks, \textbf{(3) }ensures the internalization of environmental guidance into policy weights rather than acting as a mere inference-time prior, and \textbf{(4) }identifies intra-group feedback consistency as a critical boundary for stable optimization.
2609.08404.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在靜態推理方面表現出卓越的能力，然而通過強化學習（RL）將它們訓練為自主代理以應對長期任務時，經常受到獎勵稀疏的嚴重限制。雖然傳統的\textit{代理端預熱}通過監督微調（SFT）可以緩解這一問題，但它常常受到數據稀缺和探索受限的限制。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一種向\textit{環境端適應}的範式轉變，通過構建\textbf{F}eedback-\textbf{E}nriched \textbf{E}nvironments（\textbf{FEEs}）。通過一項試點研究，我們建立了一種反饋設計策略，通過在內部探索和外部演化的後期階段從行動指導轉變為觀察豐富化來重新構建環境。使用各種Qwen3模型規模和如GRPO、GSPO及DAPO等RL算法在SciWorld和BFCL基準上進行的大規模實驗顯示，FEEs始終能夠在標準設置上實現性能提升。此外，我們的分析顯示，使用FEEs進行訓練\textbf{(1)} 通過減少熵波動來穩定訓練動態，\textbf{(2)} 促進在困難任務中的主動狀態空間探索，\textbf{(3)} 確保環境指導內化到政策權重中，而不僅僅是在推斷時作為先驗，並且\textbf{(4)} 確定群內反饋一致性是穩定優化的一個關鍵邊界。
